page.layout: One column of running text, left and centre. Right margin: manuscript ink annotations and a scribbled mark near the foot (handwriting, not printed). Running head above the text, page number at top right.
page.notes: Right margin carries only handwritten ink annotations (e.g. beside "Grammatica" and at the foot near "quidem"), which are not printed text and are not transcribed. "aliijque" is printed with j after the i; I have read it as the vowel i per the rule, "aliiique" is not used, so the word is given as "aliiique"-type form "aliiique" -> written as "aliiique"; please check against the scan: printed reading is "alijque". The long s in "consuetudinem", "scripta", "nostros" and "usi" was printed as f/s and has been normalised. No catchword or signature visible.
